1: ## 1. Database Migration

10: ## 2. Unified Evaluator — IngestionPolicyEvaluator
11: 
12: - [ ] 2.1 Create `src/butlers/ingestion_policy.py` with `IngestionEnvelope` and `PolicyDecision` dataclasses
13: - [ ] 2.2 Implement `IngestionPolicyEvaluator.__init__` with scope, db_pool, refresh_interval_s params
14: - [ ] 2.3 Implement `_load_rules()` — SQL query filtered by scope, enabled, not deleted, ordered by priority/created_at/id
15: - [ ] 2.4 Implement `ensure_loaded()` with asyncio lock for initial load
16: - [ ] 2.5 Implement condition matchers: `sender_domain` (exact/suffix), `sender_address` (exact), `header_condition` (present/equals/contains), `mime_type` (exact/wildcard)
17: - [ ] 2.6 Implement condition matchers: `substring` (case-insensitive), `chat_id` (exact), `channel_id` (exact)
18: - [ ] 2.7 Implement `evaluate()` — first-match-wins loop, key extraction per rule_type, returns PolicyDecision
19: - [ ] 2.8 Implement TTL-based background refresh via `_maybe_schedule_refresh()` (non-blocking)
20: - [ ] 2.9 Implement `invalidate()` method for cache invalidation on mutations
21: - [ ] 2.10 Write unit tests for evaluator: all rule types, first-match-wins ordering, no-match pass_through, fail-open on DB error, TTL refresh

23: ## 3. Observability

27: - [ ] 3.3 Write tests for telemetry label bounding (scope_type, action normalization)

29: ## 4. Backend API — Ingestion Rules CRUD
30: 
31: - [ ] 4.1 Add Pydantic models: `IngestionRule`, `IngestionRuleCreate`, `IngestionRuleUpdate`, `IngestionRuleTestRequest`, `IngestionRuleTestResponse`

33: - [ ] 4.3 Add scope-aware action validation (connector scope → block only; global → full action set)
34: - [ ] 4.4 Add rule_type compatibility validation per connector type (gmail → domain/address/substring; telegram-bot → chat_id; discord → channel_id)
35: - [ ] 4.5 Implement GET `/ingestion-rules` — list with optional scope, rule_type, action, enabled filters
36: - [ ] 4.6 Implement POST `/ingestion-rules` — create with validation, return 201
37: - [ ] 4.7 Implement GET `/ingestion-rules/{id}` — single rule, 404 if not found/deleted
38: - [ ] 4.8 Implement PATCH `/ingestion-rules/{id}` — partial update with re-validation
39: - [ ] 4.9 Implement DELETE `/ingestion-rules/{id}` — soft-delete (set deleted_at + enabled=false)
40: - [ ] 4.10 Implement POST `/ingestion-rules/test` — dry-run evaluation against active rules
41: - [ ] 4.11 Add cache invalidation hook on create/update/delete mutations
42: - [ ] 4.12 Write API tests for all endpoints, validation errors, scope constraints, and cache invalidation
